gloss: to take advantage of; to multiply

definitions.gloss: to take advantage of; to exploit (an opportunity or weakness)
definitions.explanation: To seize upon a situation, moment of weakness, or confusion to act in one's favor. Often implies cunning or opportunism.
To perform multiplication. A formal/literary alternative to 掛ける in mathematical contexts.

examples.japanese: {隙|すき}に{乗|じょう}じて{逃|に}げた。
examples.english: I took advantage of an opening and escaped.

examples.japanese: {混乱|こんらん}に{乗|じょう}じて{泥棒|どろぼう}が{侵入|しんにゅう}した。
examples.english: A thief broke in, taking advantage of the confusion.

examples.japanese: {災害|さいがい}に{乗|じょう}じた{悪質|あくしつ}な{詐欺|さぎ}が{報告|ほうこく}されている。
examples.english: Malicious scams exploiting the disaster have been reported.

examples.japanese: 3に5を{乗|じょう}ずると15になる。
{速度|そくど}に{時間|じかん}を{乗|じょう}じて{距離|きょり}を{求|もと}める。
examples.english: Multiply speed by time to find distance.

examples.japanese: {係数|けいすう}を{乗|じょう}じた{値|あたい}を{計算|けいさん}してください。
examples.english: Please calculate the value multiplied by the coefficient.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
This is a ずる-verb (a variant of する-verbs). Common conjugation uses {乗|じょう}じる (ichidan) rather than {乗|じょう}ずる:
- {乗|じょう}じる・{乗|じょう}じます
- て-form: {乗|じょう}じて
- た-form: {乗|じょう}じた

PATTERN (sense 1):
～に{乗|じょう}じて (taking advantage of ~)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {隙|すき}に{乗|じょう}じる (to take advantage of an opening)
- {混乱|こんらん}に{乗|じょう}じる (to exploit confusion)
- {機|き}に{乗|じょう}じる (to seize the opportunity)

SIMILAR WORDS (sense 1):
- {付|つ}け{込|こ}む: To take advantage of — implies exploiting a weakness in a more calculated way.
- {便乗|びんじょう}する: To take advantage of, to ride on — often implies riding on someone else's success or a trend.
